title: Customizing the composite
text: Three presets ship: "default" (red/blue diverging), "viridis", "okabe" (colour-blind-safe). Swap one theme:  set colours, pass straight volcano_ring_theme(): , , ns points, nes_colors (optional nes_limits) arc ramp.
code: volcano_ring(da1, en1, theme = volcano_ring_theme(palette = "okabe")) my_theme <- volcano_ring_theme(   up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC", ns = "grey80",   nes_colors = c("#053061", "white", "#67001F"),   nes_limits = c(-2.5, 2.5) ) volcano_ring(da1, en1, theme = my_theme)

title: Customizing the composite
text: centre ordinary volcano. p_threshold logfc_threshold define /call; point_size point_alpha size cloud; label_mode decides proteins get text.  cloud scaled fill disc inside ring. widest tallest points crowd arcs -log10 p label, x_scale y_scale (1 default) compress toward fold-change axis without moving axis annotations:
code: volcano_ring(da1, en1,   p_threshold = 0.01, logfc_threshold = log2(1.5),   point_size = 2.2, point_alpha = 0.6,   label_mode = "top_per_direction", label_n = 4 ) volcano_ring(da1, en1, x_scale = 0.85, y_scale = 0.9)

title: Customizing the composite
text: Arc fill NES; arc thickness magnitude choose magnitude, either "neg_log_padj" (default) "size" (gene-set size). arc_height_range sets short smallest arc tall largest arc get, can flatten exaggerate encoding.  arc_order sets arc sits within half. /split always NES sign; within half order FDR ("padj", default) enrichment strength ("nes"):
code: volcano_ring(da1, en1,   magnitude = "size",   arc_height_range = c(0.1, 2.2) ) volcano_ring(da1, en1, arc_order = "nes")

title: Customizing the composite
text: /badges count significant points; turn show_counts = FALSE, nudge count_x_mult / count_y_mult. title, subtitle, tag set text.
code: volcano_ring(da1, en1,   show_counts = FALSE,   title = "Young vs Old", subtitle = "trained", tag = "A" )

title: Customizing the composite

title: Getting started
text: pathway earns place handful proteins drive . enrichment table carries leading-edge genes, volcano_ring() draws thin tick arc genes inside volcano, pathway reads back points produced . YvO enrichment table gene column, arcs draw without ticks. two example arcs carry strongest - -regulated proteins da1 leading edge, ticks appear:  genes_col auto-detected leading_edge, leadingEdge, core_enrichment, Genes; vignette("input-contract") lists conventions upstream tool uses.
code: strongest <- function(direction, n = 6) {   hits <- da1[da1$padj < 0.05 & sign(da1$logFC) == direction, ]   head(hits[order(hits$padj), "gene"], n) } en_ticks <- data.frame(   pathway = c("Up example set", "Down example set"),   NES = c(2.1, -1.9),   padj = c(0.002, 0.006),   size = c(6L, 6L),   leading_edge = c(     paste(strongest(1), collapse = ";"),     paste(strongest(-1), collapse = ";")   ) ) suppressMessages(volcano_ring(da1, en_ticks, title = "Leading-edge ticks"))

code: curate <- function(contrast, n = 7) {   s <- en[en$contrast == contrast & en$padj < 0.05 & is.finite(en$NES), ]   s <- s[order(s$padj), ]   rbind(head(s[s$NES > 0, ], n), head(s[s$NES < 0, ], n)) } da_old <- da[da$contrast == "Training_Old", , drop = FALSE] names(da_old)[names(da_old) == "adj.P.Val"] <- "padj"  g <- suppressMessages(volcano_ring_grid(   list(Young = da1, Old = da_old),   list(Young = en1, Old = curate("Training_Old")),   ncol = 2 )) g$plot

title: Input contract
text: genes_col = NULL (default), volcano_ring() walks four conventional column names order: leading_edge (;-separated string) leadingEdge (list-column, fgsea native) core_enrichment (/-separated string, clusterProfiler GSEA) Genes (;-separated string, enrichR) First match wins. cli_alert_info() names column. match silently turns tick lines — rings still draw, just without radial tick segments inside volcano. Override genes_col = "my_column" , string column, matching genes_sep (defaults ";" column string).

title: Input contract
text: Three patterns work, increasing order intrusiveness: Argument-renames: volcano_ring(..., padj_col = "adj.P.Val"). frame mutation, good one-plots. Boundary rename: names(da)[names(da) == "adj.P.Val"] <- "padj". Useful several functions pipeline expect name. Built-column shim: write tiny adapter to_evolc(df) returns renamed frame. Worth project-specific upstream format reuse lot. DA enrichment sides disagree padj column name (e.g. adj.P.Val vs padj), one renamed boundary — padj_col single shared argument design.

title: Input contract
text: DEP::get_results() returns wide tibble one row per protein one group columns per contrast (<contrast>_ratio, <contrast>_p.val, <contrast>_p.adj). volcano_ring() wants one row per protein per contrast, single tidyr::pivot_longer() reshapes : Enrichment fgsea already shape volcano_ring() expects — reshape, rename:
code: library(tidyr) library(dplyr)  da <- DEP::get_results(dep) |>   select(name, ends_with(c("_ratio", "_p.val", "_p.adj"))) |>   pivot_longer(     -name,     names_to = c("contrast", ".value"),     names_pattern = "(.*)_(ratio|p\\.val|p\\.adj)"   ) |>   rename(gene = name, logFC = ratio, P.Value = p.val, padj = p.adj) ranks <- da |>   filter(contrast == "treated_vs_control") |>   with(setNames(logFC, gene))  en <- fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(pathways = msigdbr_list, stats = ranks) |>   mutate(contrast = "treated_vs_control")  volcano_ring(   volc_df   = filter(da, contrast == "treated_vs_control"),   enrich_df = en )

title: Volcano-in-ring composite for one contrast — volcano_ring
text: volc_df Tidy DA tibble single contrast. enrich_df Tidy enrichment tibble contrast. gene_col, logfc_col, pval_col, padj_col Column names volc_df. volc_sig_col Optional column volc_df used call point significance (e.g. pi-value), decoupled enrichment padj_col. NULL falls back padj_col pval_col. y-axis stays -log10(pval_col) regardless. term_col, nes_col, size_col Column names enrich_df. padj_col reused enrichment-side adjusted-p column. genes_col Optional column name enrich_df carrying leading-edge genes. NULL triggers auto-detect (Q4). genes_sep Separator leading-edge string. NULL defers auto-detected default. p_threshold Cutoff applied padj_col volc_df. logfc_threshold Effect-size cutoff; point called /abs(logFC) >= logfc_threshold well significant. title, subtitle, tag Plot text. volcano_radius Inner volcano radius. x_scale Horizontal compression point cloud (default 1). Values 1 pull points toward fold-change axis widest points clear enrichment ring; /axis annotations unaffected. y_scale Vertical compression point cloud (default 1), anchored fold-change axis. Values 1 lower tallest points clear -log10 p label top volcano. ring_radius Inner radius enrichment ring (default 4.8), leading-edge tick band begins. Raise widen central breathing gap around volcano, lower close . Keep volcano_radius * 0.92 point cloud clears ring. ring_thickness Radial width tick band ring_radius foot coloured arcs (default 0.55). length leading-edge ticks; widen make ticks easier read. tick_width Line width leading-edge ticks (default 0.3). label_headroom Extra radial room (data units, default 0.5) reserved beyond outermost pathway label box stays enclosed within square panel rather clipping spilling neighbour. Raise wide label boxes clipped; lower pack ring tighter. disc_color Optional fill tinted central disc. nes_limits Length-2 numeric NULL; defaults c(-3, 3). magnitude "neg_log_padj" (default) "size"; controls arc thickness encoding. arc_order Angular order arcs within /half: "padj" (default, lowest FDR first) "nes" (strongest abs(NES) first). /split always NES sign. arc_height_range Length-2 numeric c(min, max) shortest tallest arc; widen exaggerate magnitude encoding. show_counts Draw /significant-point count badges. point_size, point_alpha Volcano point size (default 1.1) opacity. label_size Pathway-label text size. label_gap Radial gap arc's outer top label (default 0.6). Anchoring per-arc keeps every leader line short length regardless arc height; label box grows outward point never overlaps arc. Widen lengthen leaders. count_size Text size /count badges (default 2.4). count_x_mult, count_y_mult Badge position fraction volcano radius (default 0.7). axis_size Text size //log2 FC/-log10 p axis annotations (default 2.2). label_mode, label_n, label_rank_by, label_genes Volcano point labels. theme Output volcano_ring_theme().

Defaults names(volc_dfs). subtitles Optional per-ring subtitles. Either vector parallel contrasts, vector named contrast. NULL draws subtitles. nrow, ncol Outer layout dims; forwarded patchwork::wrap_plots(). tag_levels Panel-tag scheme; forwarded patchwork::plot_annotation(). guides Patchwork guides argument; default "collect" collects shared NES legend. panel_spacing Gutter adjacent panels, millimetres (default 1.5). Applied half panel edge, neighbours sit panel_spacing apart. Lower pack rings closer. panel_margin Outer margin around whole grid, millimetres (default 2). Forwarded volcano_ring(); raise labels clip, lower enlarge rings. legend_position Placement collected NES legend: "bottom" (default, recovers right-hand gap), "right", "none". legend_width Length NES colourbar long axis, millimetres (default 26, tuned bottom bar). Sets key width legend horizontal, key height vertical; side legend usually wants larger value (~40). ... Forwarded volcano_ring() call (e.g. gene_col, padj_col, magnitude, theme).

code: da <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "examples", "yvo_da.csv",   package = "enrichVolcano" )) en <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "examples", "yvo_enrichment.csv",   package = "enrichVolcano" )) names(da)[names(da) == "adj.P.Val"] <- "padj"  # up to eight GO-BP terms per contrast, one composite each en_go <- en[en$database == "GO_BP" & en$padj < 0.01, ] en_go <- en_go[order(en_go$padj), ] en_go <- en_go[!duplicated(en_go[c("contrast", "pathway")]), ] en_go <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(en_go, en_go$contrast), head, 8))  g <- volcano_ring_grid(da, en_go, contrasts = c("Training_Young", "Training_Old")) #> No tick-line column found; tick lines off. #> No tick-line column found; tick lines off. g$plot

title: Theme + palette for volcano_ring() — volcano_ring_theme
text: base_size Numeric base font size. base_family Character base font family; "" defers ggplot2. palette One "default" (red-blue diverging, YvO 2026 lock), "viridis" (5-stop magma cuts), "okabe" (Okabe-Ito CB-safe pair). Sets starting / / non-significant colours NES ramp; , , ns, nes_colors override . , , ns Optional single colours overriding palette's -regulated, -regulated, non-significant point colours. nes_colors Optional colour vector overriding diverging NES ramp. supplied without nes_stops, stops spread evenly across nes_limits (c(-3, 3)). nes_limits Optional length-2 numeric. NULL, colour scale volcano_ring() uses default. nes_stops Optional numeric vector matching NES ramp length, overriding palette's nes_values.

New vignette("customizing") walks colour, volcano, ring, layout knobs section section. volcano_ring_grid() exposes composite-layout knobs: panel_spacing, panel_margin, label_headroom, legend_position ("bottom", "right", "none"), legend_width. shared NES legend now collects along bottom default. volcano_ring() gains ring_thickness tick_width leading-edge tick band, label_gap gap arc label, count_size / axis_size badge axis-annotation text. title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: ev_volcano_ring() -> volcano_ring() ev_compose() -> volcano_ring_grid() (signature changed; now takes paired lists tidy DA + enrichment frames keyed contrast, returns S3 volcano_ring_grid object carrying $plot $data). ev_theme() -> volcano_ring_theme() (new args: base_family, nes_limits, nes_stops; palettes: "default", "viridis", "okabe"). print.enrichVolcano() -> print.volcano_ring_grid(). ev_volcano() ring_plot() removed entirely — composite plot.

title: enrichVolcano 0.3.0
text: Column-naming arguments volcano_ring(): gene_col, logfc_col, pval_col, padj_col, term_col, nes_col, size_col, genes_col, genes_sep. Defaults assume limma + fgsea conventional names. Tick-line column auto-detect: leading_edge (;-string), leadingEdge (list-col), core_enrichment (/-string), Genes (;-string) work box. Override via genes_col. Structured error classes: enrichVolcano_input_error, enrichVolcano_column_error, enrichVolcano_data_error, enrichVolcano_param_error — parent enrichVolcano_error. magnitude = c("neg_log_padj", "size") controls arc-thickness encoding ring.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: default fgsea ranking statistic (rank_by) now "t", limma / proteoDA moderated t-statistic, instead "signed_p". recommended signed GSEA statistic moderated linear models (Subramanian 2005 PNAS; Reimand 2019 Nat Protoc) matches hand-written source pipelines. Inputs without t column (e.g. edgeR) fall back "signed_p" automatically, limma-family results change. Pass rank_by = "signed_p" restore previous behaviour.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: ev_enrich(nperm = ...) now actually takes effect — passed fgsea::fgseaMultilevel() nPermSimple (previously -op). ev_collapse(keep_by = "NES") now ranks representatives |NES|, strongly -regulated pathway longer dropped favour weakly -regulated one. ev_collapse() longer collapses - -regulated pathway share leading-edge genes — dedup now within-direction. adjust_p(method = "qvalue") falls back BH (warning) instead erroring contrast p-values estimate pi0. ev_validate() guards MaxQuant ratios <= 0 (set NA warning) instead producing -Inf/NaN log2 values. ev_read_contrasts() longer creates duplicate adj.P.Val column padj collides existing one. ev_compose() matches volcano/ring lists name (order-insensitive) rather requiring identical name order.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: ev_collapse(scope = ...) accepts vector stages run order, e.g. c("within_db", "cross_db"): stage collapses survivors previous, redundancy can cleaned within database first merged across databases. cutoff may one value per stage. (Within/across database redundancy control follows Vivar 2013 ReCiPa, PMID 23758478.) ev_volcano_ring() enrich_volcano() gain nes_limits (default c(-3, 3)) widen NES colour scale enrichment exceeds |NES| = 3. ev_collapse() gains similarity argument selecting gene-overlap metric Jaccard-family steps: "jaccard" (default), "overlap" (, catches small set contained larger one), "combined" (Cytoscape EnrichmentMap coefficient ; Merico 2010, PMID 21085593), combined_weight (default 0.5). Forwarded enrich_volcano(dedup = ...). Default behaviour unchanged (similarity = "jaccard"). ev_collapse() default method now "collapse_then_jaccard", matching source pipeline generated YvO 2025 figures. previous default "jaccard" remains available; alias "" deprecated removed future release. ev_collapse() gains sig_threshold (default 0.05) non-significant pathways longer affected dedup. Pass NA restore previous dedup--rows behavior. ev_enrich() gains include_terms filter_mode = c("","display") pre-test post-hoc pathway-name filtering. See vignette("pathway-dedup") use . ev_enrich() output now carries ev_filter attribute recording filter inputs per-database pathway counts filtering.

title: enrichVolcano 0.2.0
text: enrich_volcano() longer pins method = "jaccard" dedup default; hero function now inherits whatever default ev_collapse() ships, users calling wrapper defaults get documented "collapse_then_jaccard" behavior. ev_collapse_fgsea() now looks pathway gene sets (database, pathway) rather name alone. previous flatten preserved duplicate pathway names across databases, user combining (example) custom GMT MSigDB collection shared pathway name get first database’s gene set rows. ev_collapse_fgsea() now partitions input contrast runs fgsea::collapsePathways per contrast matching gene-level rank vector. Previously, scope = "global" multiple contrasts, every pathway silently scored first contrast’s ranks. ev_collapse(method = "jaccard_then_collapse") (deprecated "" alias) now passes Jaccard survivors collapse step writes back positionally, mirroring "collapse_then_jaccard". previous -merge drop members redundant cluster collapsePathways Jaccard’s keep_by tie-breaker disagreed row represented cluster. ev_enrich() ev_filter$n_pathways_after now structurally parallel n_pathways_before even every contrast empty (previously integer(0) instead named integer keyed database).
